author: Bobby Grayson
title: Integrator lessons: (1) two builders who never see each other's files wrote the same generic lemmas under the same names (WatchdogLive/TtlLive: List.mem_eraseIdx_of_ne with opposite ≠ orientation, findIdx_eraseIdx_le with two different statements, the Sys.timers group); git merges cleanly, Lean fails only at the top-level import; grep the generic namespaces before merging. (2) zsh does not word-split unquoted variables, so a loop that passes '--pid Lock=server' as one word silently makes the translator derive the name; check.sh's literal commands are the reference. (3) Theorem count convention: lines starting with 'theorem ' (487 on round 4, 724 now); the regex with attributes/indentation gives 495/737
